phase: Website UI clarity and copy-reduction pass
goal: Make public NetCoin sites easier to scan by reducing visible copy, collapsing secondary navigation, and preserving proof/accessibility tokens.

design_flaws_found.finding: The feature directory was always visible, competing with the primary page job.
design_flaws_found.fix: Changed it into a collapsed Directory control.

design_flaws_found.finding: Injected product-completion panels repeated long explanations and diluted the main action.
design_flaws_found.fix: Rewrote panels into short title, short intro, compact cards, and one next step.

design_flaws_found.finding: Local notes explained the same privacy idea too many times.
design_flaws_found.fix: Reduced to one short sentence and a shorter Save action.

design_flaws_found.finding: Mode/profile descriptions used full lists in a cramped toolbar.
design_flaws_found.fix: Compressed mode descriptions to the current task set.

design_flaws_found.finding: Directory link subtitles were too long for small screens.
Completion cards had too much padding and too much paragraph copy.
design_flaws_found.fix: Added v0.42 compact card density and shorter copy.

design_flaws_found.finding: Several pages used internal project language before user-facing tasks.
design_flaws_found.fix: Replaced generic Phase 0/1 prose with action-first labels.

design_flaws_found.finding: Users had to read several paragraphs before finding status or next steps.
design_flaws_found.fix: Moved status badges and next-step language into compact visual blocks.

implemented_changes: added v0.42 compact CSS density layer
synced shared shell assets to every site
added UI polish checker and tests
non_goals: No removal of strict proof or accessibility tokens
